research_question: Can actual close-confirmed directional-change events be routed before entry into accepted intrinsic-time overshoot versus failed leverage-driven transition with enough after-cost stability and independent frequency?

scenario.event_clock: directional-change intrinsic time rather than fixed physical-time pattern matching
scenario.threshold: at the start of each intrinsic leg, freeze the larger of prior-only one-hour realized sigma and twice the total screening cost; do not update it until the next directional-change confirmation
scenario.confirmation_price: the actual completed five-minute close that first exceeds the frozen reversal threshold; theoretical threshold-touch prices are not used

state_router.DC_ACCEPTED_OVERSHOOT: the directional change is not a perp-only move, spot was aligned, OI is not contracting, and the next completed bar extends with aligned flow, spot, index and peer breadth; trade the new intrinsic direction
state_router.DC_FAILED_TRANSITION_RECLAIM: the directional change is perp-led with abnormal OI contraction, and the next completed bar fails, OI contraction stops, futures flow flips and spot does not follow; trade back against the failed transition
state_router.UNRESOLVED: all other directional changes are no-trade

scenario.exit: the next opposite directional-change confirmation or a four-hour day-trading cap, whichever occurs first
scenario.geometry_note: A route surviving this screen must retain the frozen intrinsic threshold as its same-leg geometry when implemented with actual NautilusTrader orders.

data.futures_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly futures 5m klines and indexPriceKlines
data.state_source: Binance Vision USD-M daily 5m metrics using base sum_open_interest
data.visibility: event and state use completed bars only; route confirmation is the separately completed next bar

evaluation.same_event_arbitration: same five-minute intrinsic event timestamp chooses the highest fixed context-times-state score
evaluation.overlap_policy: no selected event before the active event-based exit

decision_contract.advance: Only the frozen intrinsic-time router passing development, year-long stability, latest pulse, costs, frequency and concentration advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not optimize the directional-change threshold or state cutoffs after evaluation. Preserve only a route positive across every declared split and move to another independent mechanism.
